_comment: Kerning pairs (1/1000 em, from TJ adjustments), advance widths (1/1000 em) and FontDescriptor metrics [ascent, descent, leading, capHeight] of Apple fonts, measured from the acceptance-set PDFs exported by Numbers/Keynote/Pages. Extended 2026-11-05 from the 497-file set: new fonts added; new kerning pairs only when negative, |v|<=150 and without whitespace (TJ gaps from tabs/justification are not kerning). Extended 2026-11-06 with the FontDescriptor metrics of families missing until then. Widths extended 2026-11-06 from the expected PDFs' own /Widths and /W arrays (2937 of 2938 overlapping values agreed). Source Sans/Code Pro are left out: Apple's own Macs often lack them and export those documents in Helvetica.
